title: Organized Faith & Heresies
body: Institutional religion sheet detailing sacred texts, clerical orders, liturgy, relics, calendar feasts, and splinter sects.

sampleValues.Central Creation & Afterlife Belief: Mortal souls are embers lent by the First Sun; honorable lives return as guiding stars while oathbreakers wander as cold mist.
sampleValues.Sacred Texts & Language: The Seven Vigils, chanted in High Solaric
sampleValues.Clerical Ranks & Authority:
Wick-Novice | Tends village lamps | Grey linen
Arch-Precentor | Guards cathedral flame | Gold-hemmed mantle
sampleValues.Pilgrimage Sites & Relics: The Glass Abbey of Suncrest, housing a shard of meteoric amber that never cools.
sampleValues.Rival Sects & Branded Heresies: The Ash-Keepers argue that darkness is sacred rest and extinguish shrines on new moons.
